investigation_notes.Hash Reputation: No malicious or suspicious detections on VirusTotal; community score 1 with one harmless vote.
investigation_notes.Script Summary: The PowerShell command retrieves the Authenticode signature for C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe, converts the signature output to compressed JSON, and Base64-encodes that JSON.
investigation_notes.Description: The executed PowerShell command collects the Authenticode signature of the local Chrome binary, converts it to compressed JSON, and Base64-encodes the result, which is consistent with benign signature or integrity collection rather than destructive or persistence behavior. The initiating process is GoogleUpdate.exe and the SHA256 has no detections on VirusTotal, there are no external network indicators, and the referenced file path matches a standard Chrome installation. The execution lineage (services.exe -> GoogleUpdate.exe -> powershell) and the observable script content reduce the likelihood of malicious activity, supporting a Low Priority classification.
